title: Learning accuracy as a real number
statement: Let a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input have dimension $n>0$, accuracy $a/b$ with integers $a>0$ and $2a\le b$, and an integer Fourier bound $S\ge1$. Its learning parameter, viewed as a real number, equals the real accuracy $a/b$.
hypotheses_covered: twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
Fourier bound is an integer at least one
